sentences.en: The concert hall was beautifully decorated for the event.
sentences.zh: 演奏厅为了这次活动布置得很漂亮。

sentences.en: I enjoy listening to classical music in the concert hall.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在演奏厅里听古典音乐。

sentences.en: The acoustics of the concert hall are fantastic for live performances.
sentences.zh: 这个演奏厅的音响效果对现场演出来说非常棒。
